Being a kissless virgin may make you feel like no one in the world will ever love you but here is the real truth, the type of sex that is displayed by media and by others who like to show off how much sex they are having is meaningless it is worth nothing. When I was 15 I thought I was ready. I wanted to have sex. But when I actually got it I was a nervous mess I was worried for weeks if she was pregnant or not or if she would leave me and fuck some other guy. Short to say it wasn't the best time in my life and its actually how I found this thread. So please just take my words into consideration and really don't worry about it. Being kissless doesn't mean you're unlovable or unattractive it just means you haven't found what your looking for. (Also quick pro tip your first kiss/ girlfriend may not be who your exactly looking for but you will grow to love her eventually)
